# Welcome to My Portfolio

Hello, myself Naveen Krishna. I am working as Data Scientist at [Tiger Analytics](https://www.tigeranalytics.com/), based in Hyderabad, India. With a eight years of industry experience, I bring expertise in tackling diverse analytical challenges across various domains and empowering the business to make data-driven decisions.

Here, you will find updates on my career journey, insightful blog posts and tutorials covering a wide range of topics relevant to my expertise.

Thank you for taking the time to explore my portfolio. Feel free to drop an e-mail @ [naveen.parimi95@gmail.com](mailto:naveen.parimi95@gmail.com) if you have any questions or opportunities for collaboration.
